{{Navbar-GlobalBioenergyPowerTracker}}
'''Äänekoski Bioproduct Mill power station''' is an operating power station of at least 260-megawatts (MW) in Central Finland, Western and Central Finland, Finland.
It is also known as Äänekosken biotuotetehdas Cogen Power Plant, Metsa Aanekoski (Sellu).
